body: Market appears to price peak M&HCV earnings that fall after the April-2027 pre-buy (12.9x trailing, ~26x normalised). Our view: agree on direction; no claimable mispricing. We add two negatives the market may under-weight - FY26 like-for-like revenue ~flat vs industry +16% (direct-sales gross-up) and an annually renewed 4.5%-of-sales technical fee to the Cummins group that minorities cannot vote on - and one positive: net cash 15% of mcap and through-cycle ROIC ~15%, so the left tail is a cyclical drawdown, not ruin. Proves us wrong: FY27 revenue >= Rs 2,500 cr AND H1 FY28 revenue within 10% of H1 FY27; fee stable on a multi-year agreement; FY27 growth >= industry + 5 pts. Scored by thesis:paper-call:AUTOAXLES:*.

data.market_view: cyclical peak earnings; de-rating ahead of the post-pre-buy downturn
data.our_view: agree; no claimable mispricing; mild negative tilt (content lag, parent fee)

title: Automotive Axles (AUTOAXLES) variant view, Nov 2026: cheap for a reason (cyclical peak + parent fee); no claimable mispricing
